series: けむりのとなり 暴走編
reading_order: 各話 ①左の導入 → ②右のオチ。各ページの話は上→下。横反転ではなく、この順序で新規作画。
user_direction: もっとトチ狂った漫画。キャラの個性を過剰に暴走させる。りゅうじは白チェックの現行採用デザイン。
canon_status: 不条理ギャグの番外編。誇張や不可能な出来事は本編の新能力・設定変更ではない。

rows: LEFT ①: in Ryuji's imposing yakuza-office shop, Hajime politely tells Ryuji 「ミント、苦手で。」 Ryuji calmly notes it in an ordinary order pad. RIGHT ②: wildly overblown security checkpoint across the same office; two stern adult suited guards gently escort a tiny PERSONIFIED WALKING MINT SPRIG out through a barrier, its leaves drooping. Large sign 「ミント出禁」. Ryuji in WHITE CHECK SUIT stamps a tiny order memo with solemn authority saying 「徹底する。」 Hajime boggles and asks 「国家？」 No violence, it is absurd hospitality.

LEFT ①: Ryuji looks at a single tiny completely COLD black charcoal cube sitting in a little dish, announcing 「引退だ。」 Hajime assumes normal cleanup. RIGHT ②: enormous elaborate retirement-awards stage, flower tributes and confetti, little COLD CHARCOAL CUBE mascot sits on a tiny red velvet throne, Ryuji and suited grown men crying grateful tears and bowing to it. Ryuji says 「お疲れさん。」 Hajime holding a stopwatch in the audience thinks 「一時間勤務。」 No hookah, no flames, cube not burning. Stage crowd is absurdly huge, cube still tiny.

LEFT ①: Hajime stands by Ryuji with a plain small water glass, politely asks 「一口、いいですか？」 No smoking or pipe shown. RIGHT ②: Ryuji has produced a ridiculous enormous FAMILY TREE SCROLL that unrolls out the window between city buildings, thousands of little stern adult portraits. One highlighted branch connects Ryuji's white-check portrait and Hajime's black-cap portrait with text 「五厘の兄弟」. Ryuji emotionally says 「兄弟だ。」 Hajime buried in scroll says 「親戚、増えた。」 Huge scale shift, no real legal family records.

LEFT ①: late at night in the black leather office sofa, relaxed Hajime asks 「もう少しいいですか。」 Ryuji nods hospitably. RIGHT ②: the same black leather sofa is now floating in a ridiculous COSMIC VOID of galaxies, calendar ages have passed; Ryuji STILL in white-check suit/purple tie/moustache/sunglasses gently offers a water glass on a little tray, saying 「お冷だ。」 A small receipt clearly says 「延長１億年」. Hajime looks around at planets, asking 「まだ営業中？」 No extra pipe, no disaster, deadpan infinity-hospitality.

LEFT ①: Hajime at Adam's shop studies fruit menu and asks 「他の味は？」 Adam in black Henley, red/green short hair, clean-shaven, thinks gravely. RIGHT ②: Adam has changed the ENTIRE WORLD instead of his menu: behind them a giant globe is split into RED APPLE and GREEN APPLE hemispheres, paired apple planets/suns and apple clouds, the cafe window is a cosmic observatory. Adam grandly gestures saying 「選び放題だ。」 Hajime clutches the unchanged two-apple menu and says 「どこが。」 Important hair front view red screen-left, green screen-right, no facial hair/glasses.

LEFT ①: Adam very formally gives Hajime a fancy invitation, expression grave, saying 「大事な報告だ。」 Hajime attentive. RIGHT ②: a magnificent overblown WEDDING CHAPEL with confetti and ribbons; adult Adam as groom in elegant BLACK TUXEDO retaining his RED/GREEN short hair is solemnly marrying TWO NORMAL APPLES (one red, one green) placed together on a tiny bridal cushion wearing a tiny veil. Adam says 「生涯、これだけ。」 Hajime guest looks stunned, says 「相手、味？」 Absurd romantic dedication to a flavor, no human bride or second Adam.

LEFT ①: professional Adam expertly studies a precise digital thermometer and timer, focused, says 「温度は完璧だ。」 No hot apparatus visible. RIGHT ②: he has built a giant ridiculous scientific ritual of monitors, apple-shaped diagrams and precise measuring tools around an ORDINARY RICE COOKER, but is completely lost with its simple buttons. He kneels earnestly asking 「炊飯、どれだ？」 Hajime points at the ONE large button 「炊飯」, saying 「そこです。」 Adam remains young, CLEAN SHAVEN, NO GLASSES.

LEFT ①: Adam at the door proudly tells Hajime 「部屋、整えた。」 Hajime cautiously opens his own apartment door. RIGHT ②: EVERY object in Hajime's whole ordinary apartment—sofa, fridge, walls, curtains, lamps, rug—is meticulously split exactly HALF RED / HALF GREEN, one straight central laser line. No apples forced onto heads. Adam with precision gauge proudly announces 「１：１だ。」 Hajime stands astonished in his BLACK CAP/BLACK HOODIE, shouting 「俺の家！」 His clothes stay black, he is not painted red/green.

LEFT ①: black-haired green-eyed working Minto in black/neon-green devil cafe costume excitedly gives Hajime an election ballot, saying 「総選挙だよ♡」 RIGHT ②: huge ridiculous IDOL ELECTION STADIUM full of posters; EVERY candidate poster is the SAME Minto in different poses, all ballot boxes have her portrait, audience seats completely empty except Hajime. Minto on grand podium with trophy says 「接戦でした♡」 Hajime holding his lone ballot asks 「相手、誰？」 Same adult Minto, no real idol logos or political real-world reference.

LEFT ①: professionally confident WORKING Minto, black long hair/green eyes, devil horns and black/NEON GREEN costume, teasingly winks and says 「好きになっちゃうよ♡」 Hajime smiles. RIGHT ②: AFTER WORK same woman in BEIGE CARDIGAN/white blouse/DARK LONG SKIRT, NO horns, SAME black long hair and green eyes. Hajime sincerely tells her 「俺は、好きです。」 Her brain humorously freezes: she is blushing enormously with wide eyes, tiny pink cartoon computer error rectangles orbit her head, one big readable caption 「応答なし」. Not a medical emergency, not a robot body; simple romantic overload visual.

LEFT ①: Hajime seriously holds a digital kitchen scale and asks adult gyaru Ageha 「何グラム？」 Ageha playfully gestures intuition, bear clips/leopard jacket/pink top. RIGHT ②: the laws of measurement have broken: a bright PINK physical HEART-SHAPED CRYSTAL of pure 'kyun' sits on scale, digital display clearly reads 「１きゅん」 instead of grams. Ageha happily says 「このくらい！」 Hajime stares at the scale, saying 「単位が増えた。」 Whimsical physics made visible, not actual tobacco preparation.

LEFT ①: inside pink/leopard MELTY PUFF, Ageha hugs ONE cute new pink teddy bear and begs 「あと一匹だけ♡」 Hajime mildly concerned at nearby bears. RIGHT ②: gigantic wide street view: the ENTIRE cafe building has become a GIANT PINK TEDDY BEAR formed of thousands of white/pink plushies, bear head is the storefront, paws are doors, eyes are windows. Ageha and BLACK-CAP Hajime peek from the eye windows. Hajime says 「店がクマ。」 Delightfully ludicrous scale. Shop sign can read 「MELTY PUFF」. No ordinary generic plants.
りゅうじ・ましろ・はじめ

LEFT ①: stern Ryuji in WHITE CHECK suit/purple tie/moustache/tinted sunglasses tells Hajime 「対策会議だ。」 He points to a vague gigantic frightening silhouette of the rumored 'Cigarman' on a board. RIGHT ②: grand emergency command center with huge banner 「シガーマン対策本部」. Sweet ADULT pale-blonde two-braided Mashiro in beige cardigan and long green skirt has innocently been made the MEETING CHAIR, sitting in an absurdly tall executive chair, everyone earnestly trusts her. Mashiro holding a clipboard nervously says 「僕も怖いよ〜。」 Ryuji bows respectfully saying 「先生、お願いします。」 A tiny narrator arrow to MASHIRO labelled 「本人」 makes clear they appointed Cigarman to defeat Cigarman. No actual monster, smoking, hookah or weapons.
ましろ・りゅうじ・はじめ

LEFT ①: Mashiro sweetly presents a small paper takeaway bag, sleepy smile, says 「今日は軽め〜。」 Ryuji in approved WHITE CHECK suit and Hajime prepare to accept it. RIGHT ②: absurd PHYSICAL manifestation of 'heavy smoke': the paper bag contains a giant perfectly cubic BLACK-GRAY CARTOON CLOUD BRICK, resting on a wheeled trolley whose wheels comically flatten under it; small weight sign 「３トン」. The cloud-brick still has fluffy vapor edges. Ryuji solemnly braces the trolley; Mashiro effortlessly balances the bag handle with a mitten hand as a pure cartoon gag. Hajime exclaims 「重量の話？」 No smoke emitted by a person, no device or pipe, no harm. The impossible solid cloud is metaphorical cartoon matter.

LEFT ①: MUKAI, a separate mature hard-boiled gentleman with black FEDORA, dark beard and DARK SUIT, no glasses, calmly orders from Hajime 「ラテ、クマで。」 RIGHT ②: the latte's CUTE MILK FOAM BEAR has become GIANT AND ALIVE, emerging from pastel mug and gently hugging Mukai with fluffy foam paws, much bigger than him. Mukai completely unflappable, fedora still on, corrects it 「耳、大きめ。」 Hajime holding a pitcher says 「動いた。」 Bear is clearly white coffee foam, no real dangerous bear or smoking.
りゅうじ・ムカイさん・はじめ

LEFT ①: scary noir close shot of Ryuji (white large-check/purple tie/moustache/SUNGLASSES) and Mukai (DARK SUIT/FEDORA/BEARD/NO GLASSES), grave secretive posture. Ryuji says 「誰にも言うな。」 RIGHT ②: pull way back: these two grown stern men have arranged a ludicrously elaborate PINK DOLLHOUSE TEA PARTY on a tiny doll-sized table with bunny plushies, lace doilies, tiny teacups and heart-shaped biscuits. Both men perch on tiny pink chairs, keeping serious gangster/hard-boiled faces and their exact adult costumes. Hajime opens the door astonished, Ryuji offers a tiny third chair saying 「お前も座れ。」 Hajime replies 「はい。」 The enormity of secret prep and tiny toys is the punchline. NO human dolls resembling minors, only cute animal plushies.

LEFT ①: ADULT Samechan in BLACK/BLUE SHARK HOOD, black hair with blue streaks, blue eyes, holds CROWNED BLUE/WHITE shark plush Korochan, casually asks Hajime 「手伝えるかの？」 He reaches for an ordinary mop. RIGHT ②: an absurd grand ROYAL SHARK COURT has materialized, rows of crowned shark PLUSH subjects bowing. Korochan plush sits on gold throne, speech bubble clearly FROM PLUSH: 「任命する。」 Hajime in his BLACK CAP/BLACK HOODIE is now wearing an overblown royal cape and holding the SAME MOP as a scepter; a large sash says 「清掃大臣」. Hajime says 「昇進、早っ。」 Samechan proudly officiates. Not real sharks, not minors.

LEFT ①: languid Rin (dark long wolf cut/white shirt/black slacks) teasingly offers Hajime a tiny plain PERFUME TEST STRIP, asking 「何の香り？」 No tobacco or smoking involved. RIGHT ②: a surreal miniature GRAY OFFICE MONDAY has erupted like a cartoon sensory vision around the strip: tiny cubicles, alarm clocks, mountains of paperwork, giant calendar tile 「月」; Hajime stares with exaggerated emotional recognition and says 「月曜。」 Rin calmly checks her clipboard, says 「正解。」 Funny recognizable impossible fragrance, not a toxic chemical or medical event, no real company logos.

LEFT ①: Hajime meets friendly silver-haired Naru in black-and-WHITE streetwear jacket and asks 「少しだけ教えて。」 Naru happily opens one notebook. RIGHT ②: instant absurd expansion to an ENTIRE UNIVERSITY lecture theatre and campus of dessert science, Naru same silver hair and black/white jacket but with a professor's academic cap, pointing to giant cake/vanilla diagrams on the blackboard. Banner 「なる大学」. Hajime is now enrolled at a student desk surrounded by endless notebooks, his black baseball cap clearly visible. Naru warmly asks 「ノート、持った？」 Hajime astonished says 「入学してる。」 No fees or coercion: exaggerated generous teaching obsession, not evil arrogant professor.

LEFT ①: quiet Tsumugi (DARK BROWN bob/PURPLE HOODIE) shows her tablet drawing of a LEAF-EARED CAT with smoky curl tail, BLACK CAP and tiny BLACK HOODIE resembling Hajime. She says 「はじめさん描いた。」 Real adult Hajime leans over impressed. RIGHT ②: that exact CARTOON CAT drawing has stepped OFF the tablet into the cafe and is now efficiently serving THREE trays of tea and cash-register service simultaneously with an absurd array of little paper-illustration arms, tail tidying a menu. The real Hajime and Tsumugi watch, not transformed. Cat cheerfully says 「いらっしゃい。」 Hajime looks at his own empty hands and says 「俺より働く。」 Tablet shows a clear cat-shaped empty white space. No actual magic added to canon, this is the surreal spin-off cartoon.
